021/**
022 * TradeOptions
023 *
024 * @author creatorfromhell
025 * @since 6.3.0.0
026 */
027public final class TradeOptions {
028
029  public static final TradeOptions DEFAULT = builder().build();
030
031  public static final TradeOptions SILENT = builder()
032          .updateSigns(true)
033          .build();
034
035  public static final TradeOptions PREVIEW = builder()
036          .updateSigns(false)
037          .commit(false)
038          .build();
039
040  private final boolean updateSigns;
041  private final boolean commit;
042
043  private TradeOptions(final Builder builder) {
044
045    this.updateSigns = builder.updateSigns;
046    this.commit = builder.commit;
047  }
048
049  public static Builder builder() {
050
051    return new Builder();
052  }
053
054  public static Builder builder(final TradeOptions copy) {
055
056    return new Builder(copy);
057  }
058
059  public boolean updateSigns() {
060
061    return updateSigns;
062  }
063
064  public boolean commit() {
065
066    return commit;
067  }
068
069  public static final class Builder {
070
071    private boolean updateSigns = true;
072    private boolean commit = true;
073
074    private Builder() { }
075
076    private Builder(final TradeOptions copy) {
077
078      this.updateSigns = copy.updateSigns;
079      this.commit = copy.commit;
080    }
081
082    public Builder updateSigns(final boolean updateSigns) {
083
084      this.updateSigns = updateSigns;
085      return this;
086    }
087
088    public Builder commit(final boolean commit) {
089
090      this.commit = commit;
091      return this;
092    }
093
094    public TradeOptions build() {
095
096      return new TradeOptions(this);
097    }
098  }
099}
